flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-23, Region 4 Kootenay.
Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Alexander Creek. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 1-38/24.

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-23: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).
